dsh-plugin README · 安装 DSH Plugin Hub：从 npm 安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin
```

插件已发布到 npm registry（包名 `dsh-plugin`），一条命令即可安装使用，无需任何构建。

> **只提供 npm 安装**：源码 / git 安装要依赖各仓库自己的构建脚本，写法不统一、失败率高（git 包常被 pnpm 的构建脚本限制直接拦下），装出来的行为也不一致，因此不再提供。插件已内置浏览器端 bundle，npm 安装无需构建；装完重启 `dsh web`，在「设置 → 插件市场」即可使用。

dsh-plugin README · 更新 DSH Plugin Hub：插件市场检测到新版本时会提示一键更新；如果旧版本存在更新缺陷导致拉取不到最新版，请直接用命令行升级：

**方式一：直接更新到最新（推荐）**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-plugin
```

**方式二：强制升级（旧版更新不上时）**

`update` 若受旧版缺陷影响无法拉取最新版，用显式版本号强制重装最新版：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin@latest
```

**方式三：卸载重装到最新（最稳）**

`add` 对已安装的实例不覆盖版本，先卸载再安装必然拿到最新版：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin
```

> 更新后重启 `dsh web` 即可生效。

dsh-plugin README · 更新 DSH Plugin Hub：> **更新/重装后市场不见了？** 如果你在「设置 → 插件」里取消勾选过 `dsh-plugin`，profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里就没有它了——依赖还在 `node_modules`，但不会被组合，重启后市场不会出现。到「设置 → 插件」重新勾选 `dsh-plugin`；也可以把 `"dsh-plugin"` 加回 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`，再重启宿主。

Installed under **Settings → Plugin Hub**, it lets you browse, search and install community plugins without leaving the app. This is an independent community project, not affiliated with DeepSeek Harness.

dsh-plugin README · Plugin Hub Features：- **One-click install** — click and done: a serial background queue with live progress in the dialog, cancellable anytime; most plugins take effect on page refresh, no restart needed
- **One-click upgrade** — new versions are detected automatically; the card turns into "Update" and overwrite-installs in one click
- **One-click uninstall** — fully visualized with live progress; changes take effect immediately
- **Full trace** — every install / upgrade / uninstall, success or failure, is recorded in the notification center for later review

dsh-plugin README · Plugin Hub Features：**Notification center**

- Live progress and cancel for running tasks, pending restarts, and full success / failure history in one place
- Failed installs can be filed as a GitHub Issue in one click; changes take effect on refresh, and a restart is only offered when a refresh genuinely cannot help — a single "Restart now", with closing the dialog meaning "later"

**Rich catalog · human-curated**

dsh-plugin README · Plugin Hub Features：- Indexes **20,000+** community plugins on the site, **5,000+** of which ship an npm package and install in one click from the Plugin Hub; curated daily by [dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org), with every installable entry hand-verified
- Covers UI & experience, sessions & messages, memory & context, tooling and more — browse by category or search straight to it
- Every plugin shows its verification status (verified), star / fork ratings, version and last-update time — fully sourced

dsh-plugin README · Plugin Hub Features：**Bilingual · easy to filter**

- The UI follows your system language by default and switches manually anytime from the top-right; copy and plugin data switch together
- Sort by popularity / newest / earliest indexed, with bilingual descriptions and capability tags at a glance
- Filter by installed / not installed and search across names, descriptions and tags

**Always in sync · lightweight & private**

dsh-plugin README · Why DSH Plugin Hub：The DSH Plugin Hub lists **5,000+** npm-installable DeepSeek Harness plugins (out of **20,000+** indexed on the site), all hand-verified — updated daily, browse, search, download and install for free by category, fully sourced.

dsh-plugin README · Always Fresh：Newly released DSH plugins are indexed as soon as possible; descriptions, categories and compatibility status of existing plugins are refreshed on a regular basis. We keep tracking the DeepSeek Harness ecosystem so you always see the latest information.

dsh-plugin README · Human-Verified：Every DSH plugin is manually checked by a professional team — install commands, compatibility status (verified / unconfirmed) and target DSH version (dshTarget) are verified one by one, with capability categories labeled. Quality is guaranteed.

dsh-plugin README · Fully Sourced：Every DSH plugin links back to its GitHub source repository with stars, forks and last-update time; data is compiled from the DeepSeek Harness official site, official architecture docs and official repos — everything is traceable.

dsh-plugin README · Install DSH Plugin Hub：Install from npm:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin
```

The plugin is published to the npm registry as `dsh-plugin` — one command installs and it just works, no build step required.

dsh-plugin README · Install DSH Plugin Hub：> **npm installs only**: source and git installs depend on each repository's own build scripts, which are written inconsistently and fail often (git packages are routinely rejected by pnpm's build gate), and the resulting behaviour varies — so they are no longer offered. The browser bundle ships with the package, so an npm install needs no build step; restart `dsh web` and open Settings → Plugin Hub.

dsh-plugin README · Update DSH Plugin Hub：The plugin hub notifies you when a new version is available; if an older build's in-panel updater cannot pull the latest release, upgrade from the command line:

**Option 1: update in place (recommended)**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-plugin
```

**Option 2: force upgrade (when an older build cannot update)**

If the old build's updater cannot pull the latest version, force-reinstall the newest release with an explicit version:

dsh-plugin README · Update DSH Plugin Hub：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin@latest
```

**Option 3: reinstall the latest (most reliable)**

`add` does not overwrite an already-installed copy, so removing first and re-adding always fetches the newest version:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin
```

> Restart `dsh web` after updating for the changes to take effect.

dsh-plugin README · Update DSH Plugin Hub：> **Marketplace missing after an update/reinstall?** If you unchecked `dsh-plugin` under Settings → Plugins, the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` no longer lists it — the dependency stays in `node_modules` but is not composed, so the marketplace will not appear after a restart. Re-check `dsh-plugin` under Settings → Plugins, or add `"dsh-plugin"` back to `dsh.profile.bundles` in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json`, then restart the host.
